[1] Preceded by the non-album single "Charlotte Sometimes" late the previous year, "Pornography" was the band's first album with a new producer, Phil Thornalley, and was recorded at RAK Studios from January to April.
[2] It was first recorded that year in Danish (renamed "Brændt" (Danish for "Burned")) by singer Lis Sørensen, then two years later by Cutler and Preven's American alternative rock band Ednaswap, and in 1996 by American-Norwegian singer Trine Rein.
[3] "Only Teardrops" is a song recorded by Danish singer Emmelie de Forest.
[4] He is perhaps best known for co-writing (with Scott Cutler and Anne Preven) the Ednaswap song "Torn" (made famous by Natalie Imbruglia's cover version) and the number one hits "Mama Do", "Boys and Girls" and "Cry Me Out" for Pixie Lott.
